package internalapi_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	privatehandlers "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

const snapshotStudentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
const snapshotPathID = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
const snapshotHTTPPath = "/v1/students/" + snapshotStudentID + "/learning-paths/" + snapshotPathID + "/planning-snapshot"
const snapshotBody = `{"targets":[{"type":"concept","key":"go.syntax","version":"v1"}],"trigger_context":{"kind":"manual_request","reason":"inspect current owner state"}}`

// This is an API unit model. It proves strict transport and whitelisting, never
// PostgreSQL consistency, registered production composition, or live E2E.
type planningSnapshotUnitGetter struct {
	calls     int
	request   domain.PlanningSnapshotRequest
	studentID string
	pathID    string
	err       error
	mutate    func(*domain.StudentPlanningSnapshot)
}

func (getter *planningSnapshotUnitGetter) Handle(_ context.Context, sid, pid string, request domain.PlanningSnapshotRequest) (domain.StudentPlanningSnapshot, error) {
	getter.calls++
	getter.request, getter.studentID, getter.pathID = request, sid, pid
	if getter.err != nil {
		return domain.StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, getter.err
	}
	result, err := domain.BuildStudentPlanningSnapshot(planningSnapshotHTTPSource(request.Targets), request)
	if err == nil && getter.mutate != nil {
		getter.mutate(&result)
	}
	return result, err
}

func planningSnapshotHTTPSource(targets []domain.LearningTargetRef) domain.PlanningSnapshotSource {
	now := time.Date(2026, 10, 5, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	mastery := make([]domain.StudentTargetMastery, len(targets))
	for i, target := range targets {
		mastery[i] = domain.StudentTargetMastery{StudentID: snapshotStudentID, Target: target, State: domain.TargetMasteryUnknown, PolicyVersion: domain.MasteryPolicyVersion}
	}
	return domain.PlanningSnapshotSource{
		StudentID: snapshotStudentID, RequestedTargets: targets, CapturedAt: now, Mastery: mastery,
		Profile: domain.StudentOnboarding{StudentID: snapshotStudentID, DirectionCode: "backend", SelfAssessedExperience: "beginner", KnownStacks: []string{}, DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}, GoalCode: "go.backend", GoalText: "PRIVATE_GOAL_CANARY", PreferredLanguage: "ru", WeeklyMinutes: 120, PreferredPace: "steady", ProfileVersion: domain.StudentOnboardingProfileVersion, Version: 3, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now},
		Context: domain.StudentLearningContext{StudentID: snapshotStudentID, SelectedLearningPathID: snapshotPathID, Version: 4, UpdatedAt: &now},
		Path:    domain.StudentLearningPath{ID: snapshotPathID, StudentID: snapshotStudentID, CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", GoalCode: "go.backend", CourseFingerprint: strings.Repeat("a", 64), PolicyVersion: domain.LearningPathPolicyVersion, PlannerPolicyVersion: "course-planner-v1", ReasonCode: "initial_plan", ReasonSummary: "PRIVATE_REASON_CANARY", Status: domain.LearningPathStatusActive, IsPrimary: true, IsSelected: true, Version: 2, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now, Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{{ID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", Position: 0, Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, Targets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.syntax", Version: "v1"}}, ReasonCode: "first_gap", LessonContent: json.RawMessage(`{"description":"PRIVATE_LESSON_CANARY"}`)}}},
	}
}

func planningSnapshotDirectRouter(getter privatehandlers.PlanningSnapshotGetter) http.Handler {
	handler := &privatehandlers.Handler{PlanningSnapshot: getter}
	router := chi.NewRouter()
	router.Post("/v1/students/{studentID}/learning-paths/{pathID}/planning-snapshot", handler.GetPlanningSnapshot)
	return router
}

func planningSnapshotRequest(router http.Handler, path, body, contentType string) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, path, strings.NewReader(body))
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", contentType)
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	return response
}

func TestPlanningSnapshotHandlerWhitelistAndExactInputs(t *testing.T) {
	getter := &planningSnapshotUnitGetter{}
	response := planningSnapshotRequest(planningSnapshotDirectRouter(getter), snapshotHTTPPath, snapshotBody, "application/json")
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d body=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
	if getter.calls != 1 || getter.studentID != snapshotStudentID || getter.pathID != snapshotPathID || len(getter.request.Targets) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("wrong getter identity or requested targets")
	}
	if response.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" || response.Header().Get("Content-Type") != "application/json" {
		t.Fatal("snapshot cache/type headers missing")
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"PRIVATE_GOAL_CANARY", "PRIVATE_REASON_CANARY", "PRIVATE_LESSON_CANARY", "lesson_content", "goal_text", "reason_summary", "expected_answers", "solution", "workspace", "secret"} {
		if strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("private field %q exposed", forbidden)
		}
	}
	var snapshot domain.StudentPlanningSnapshot
	if err := json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &snapshot); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if snapshot.Schema != domain.StudentPlanningSnapshotSchema || snapshot.References.SnapshotRef == "" || len(snapshot.Mastery) != 1 || snapshot.Mastery[0].State != domain.TargetMasteryUnknown {
		t.Fatal("missing safe snapshot refs/mastery")
	}
	for _, signal := range []domain.PlanningSnapshotUnavailable{snapshot.Availability.EvidenceQuality, snapshot.Availability.Stability} {
		if signal.Status != "DERIVED_BY_PLANNER" || signal.Value != nil || signal.ReasonCode != "PLANNER_POLICY_HYBRID_V1" {
			t.Fatal("quality/stability must remain Planner-owned")
		}
	}
	for _, unavailable := range []domain.PlanningSnapshotUnavailable{snapshot.Availability.RuntimeHold, snapshot.Availability.AutomaticAdaptation, snapshot.Availability.StudentPinning} {
		if unavailable.Status != "UNAVAILABLE" || unavailable.Value != nil || unavailable.ReasonCode == "" {
			t.Fatal("unavailable semantics were defaulted")
		}
	}
}

func TestPlanningSnapshotHandlerRejectsMalformedBeforeRead(t *testing.T) {
	cases := map[string]string{
		"unknown root":               strings.TrimSuffix(snapshotBody, "}") + `,"extra":true}`,
		"case alias":                 strings.Replace(snapshotBody, `"targets"`, `"Targets"`, 1),
		"unknown target":             strings.Replace(snapshotBody, `"version":"v1"`, `"version":"v1","outcome":"passed"`, 1),
		"unknown trace":              strings.Replace(snapshotBody, `"kind":"manual_request"`, `"kind":"manual_request","consent":true`, 1),
		"duplicate root":             `{"targets":[{"type":"concept","key":"go.syntax"}],"targets":[],"trigger_context":{"kind":"manual_request","reason":"read"}}`,
		"duplicate target":           strings.Replace(snapshotBody, `"key":"go.syntax"`, `"key":"go.syntax","key":"go.http"`, 1),
		"duplicate escaped target":   strings.Replace(snapshotBody, `"key":"go.syntax"`, `"key":"go.syntax","k\u0065y":"go.http"`, 1),
		"duplicate trace":            strings.Replace(snapshotBody, `"kind":"manual_request"`, `"kind":"manual_request","kind":"activity_completed"`, 1),
		"null document":              `null`,
		"null targets":               `{"targets":null,"trigger_context":{"kind":"manual_request","reason":"read"}}`,
		"null target":                `{"targets":[null],"trigger_context":{"kind":"manual_request","reason":"read"}}`,
		"null version":               strings.Replace(snapshotBody, `"version":"v1"`, `"version":null`, 1),
		"null trace":                 `{"targets":[{"type":"concept","key":"go.syntax"}],"trigger_context":null}`,
		"null optional correlation":  strings.Replace(snapshotBody, `"kind":"manual_request"`, `"kind":"manual_request","correlation_id":null`, 1),
		"empty optional correlation": strings.Replace(snapshotBody, `"kind":"manual_request"`, `"kind":"manual_request","correlation_id":""`, 1),
		"foreign target shape":       `{"targets":[["concept"]],"trigger_context":{"kind":"manual_request","reason":"read"}}`,
		"duplicate exact targets":    `{"targets":[{"type":"concept","key":"go.syntax"},{"type":"concept","key":"go.syntax","version":""}],"trigger_context":{"kind":"manual_request","reason":"read"}}`,
		"empty targets":              `{"targets":[],"trigger_context":{"kind":"manual_request","reason":"read"}}`,
		"missing trace":              `{"targets":[{"type":"concept","key":"go.syntax"}]}`,
		"empty trace reason":         strings.Replace(snapshotBody, `"inspect current owner state"`, `" "`, 1),
		"trailing value":             snapshotBody + ` {}`,
		"invalid UTF8":               strings.Replace(snapshotBody, "go.syntax", string([]byte{0xff}), 1),
		"oversize document":          `{"targets":[{"type":"concept","key":"go.syntax"}],"trigger_context":{"kind":"manual_request","reason":"` + strings.Repeat("a", domain.MaximumPlanningSnapshotRequestBytes) + `"}}`,
	}
	for name, body := range cases {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			getter := &planningSnapshotUnitGetter{}
			response := planningSnapshotRequest(planningSnapshotDirectRouter(getter), snapshotHTTPPath, body, "application/json")
			if response.Code != http.StatusBadRequest || getter.calls != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("status=%d reads=%d", response.Code, getter.calls)
			}
		})
	}
	for _, contentType := range []string{"", "text/plain", "application/jsonx"} {
		getter := &planningSnapshotUnitGetter{}
		response := planningSnapshotRequest(planningSnapshotDirectRouter(getter), snapshotHTTPPath, snapshotBody, contentType)
		if response.Code != http.StatusBadRequest || getter.calls != 0 {
			t.Fatal("wrong content type caused read")
		}
	}
}

func TestPlanningSnapshotHandlerPreservesFullAllowedTargetEnvelope(t *testing.T) {
	targets := make([]domain.LearningTargetRef, 500)
	for i := range targets {
		targets[i] = domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: fmt.Sprintf("%03d", i) + strings.Repeat("k", 252), Version: strings.Repeat("v", 128)}
	}
	// Exact empty legacy version stays empty; no graph version is invented.
	targets[0].Version = ""
	body, err := json.Marshal(domain.PlanningSnapshotRequest{Targets: targets, TriggerContext: domain.PlanningSnapshotTrigger{Kind: "caller-defined-trace", Reason: "bounded caller trace", CorrelationID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	getter := &planningSnapshotUnitGetter{}
	response := planningSnapshotRequest(planningSnapshotDirectRouter(getter), snapshotHTTPPath, string(body), "application/json; charset=utf-8")
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK || getter.calls != 1 || len(getter.request.Targets) != 500 {
		t.Fatalf("full existing target envelope rejected: status=%d reads=%d body=%s", response.Code, getter.calls, response.Body.String())
	}
	if getter.request.Targets[0].Version != "" {
		t.Fatal("legacy target version was invented")
	}
	targets = append(targets, domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "over-limit"})
	body, _ = json.Marshal(domain.PlanningSnapshotRequest{Targets: targets, TriggerContext: domain.PlanningSnapshotTrigger{Kind: "trace", Reason: "read"}})
	getter = &planningSnapshotUnitGetter{}
	response = planningSnapshotRequest(planningSnapshotDirectRouter(getter), snapshotHTTPPath, string(body), "application/json")
	if response.Code != http.StatusBadRequest || getter.calls != 0 {
		t.Fatal("501 target request caused read")
	}
}

func TestPlanningSnapshotHandlerIdentityAndSafeFailures(t *testing.T) {
	for name, err := range map[string]error{"missing": domain.ErrNotFound, "conflict": domain.ErrConflict, "invalid": domain.ErrValidation, "storage": errors.New("PRIVATE_STORAGE_SECRET")} {
		want := map[string]int{"missing": 404, "conflict": 409, "invalid": 422, "storage": 500}[name]
		getter := &planningSnapshotUnitGetter{err: err}
		response := planningSnapshotRequest(planningSnapshotDirectRouter(getter), snapshotHTTPPath, snapshotBody, "application/json")
		if response.Code != want || strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), "PRIVATE_STORAGE_SECRET") {
			t.Fatalf("wrong safe error: %d %s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
		}
	}
	response := planningSnapshotRequest(planningSnapshotDirectRouter(nil), snapshotHTTPPath, snapshotBody, "application/json")
	if response.Code != 503 {
		t.Fatal("missing owner port must fail closed")
	}
	for _, path := range []string{strings.Replace(snapshotHTTPPath, snapshotStudentID, "invalid", 1), strings.Replace(snapshotHTTPPath, snapshotPathID, "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", 1)} {
		getter := &planningSnapshotUnitGetter{}
		response := planningSnapshotRequest(planningSnapshotDirectRouter(getter), path, snapshotBody, "application/json")
		if response.Code != 400 || getter.calls != 0 {
			t.Fatal("invalid URL identity caused read")
		}
	}
	for name, mutate := range map[string]func(*domain.StudentPlanningSnapshot){
		"foreign learner":         func(s *domain.StudentPlanningSnapshot) { s.StudentID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777" },
		"foreign path":            func(s *domain.StudentPlanningSnapshot) { s.LearningPathID = "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888" },
		"tampered ref":            func(s *domain.StudentPlanningSnapshot) { s.References.SnapshotRef = strings.Repeat("b", 64) },
		"different requested set": func(s *domain.StudentPlanningSnapshot) { s.RequestedTargets[0].Key = "go.http" },
		"different trace":         func(s *domain.StudentPlanningSnapshot) { s.TriggerContext.Reason = "different caller" },
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			getter := &planningSnapshotUnitGetter{mutate: mutate}
			response := planningSnapshotRequest(planningSnapshotDirectRouter(getter), snapshotHTTPPath, snapshotBody, "application/json")
			if response.Code != 500 {
				t.Fatalf("malformed owner result emitted: %d", response.Code)
			}
		})
	}
}
